retrieved_synopses: Shadowheart reacts to the player trying to steal the mysterious gith artefact.

Venturing farther into what is now a goblin camp but was once a temple of Selûne (the moon goddess, rival to her own goddess, Shar), Shadowheart reacts with disgust. She notes how the crude goblin decoration is an improvement upon the surviving signs of Selûne worship. If Shadowheart isn't known to be a Shar worshipper, her comments are a little more veiled.

Shadowheart comments upon a statue of Selûne, located somewhat incongruously in a camp full of goblin marauders. Shadowheart is a little perturbed by the statue's presence, but quickly dismissive of it. Selûne is a rival to her own goddess; the statue deserves an ignominious fate. If Shadowheart is not know to be a Shar worshipper, she's a little more reserved in her comments.

Shadowheart reacts to taking offerings made at a shrine to Selûne, the rival of her goddess Shar. If Shadowheart is the avatar, she has a moment of introspection where she considers if she should take the items of not. If Shadowheart is a companion, she encourages the player to not take the items. The player can try talk her around, and may discover she is a Shar worshipper if they don't already know. The outcome of this dialogue potentially strengthens or damages Shadowheart's opinion of the player.
The player passes comment after they manage to open a magically sealed chest by reciting a prayer they found. If Shadowheart or a worshipper of Shar is speaking, the prayer does nothing.
context: The player has just stolen a Selûne relic from a shrine and the candles around it have gone out, prompting Shadowheart to react. Shadowheart is a worshipper of Shar (Selûne’s rival) and has previously shown disgust or dismissiveness toward surviving Selûne worship in this ruined temple-now-goblin-camp, so her response is defiantly contemptuous rather than frightened. Off-screen actions that led here may include the player opening a magically sealed chest or attempting to pilfer other offerings or artefacts; Shadowheart’s attitude can vary if she’s the party’s avatar or a companion. Her tone and comments in this moment can reveal her religion and affect her opinion of the player.
